templates.title: Zabbix
templates.description: Zabbix 7.0 LTS monitoring with TimescaleDB. Using traefikv2 rProxy (should be preinstalled on your docker platform). Server tuning defaults are sized for roughly 1300 hosts and 130 new values per second.
templates.note: TimescaleDB hypertables and compression policies are created by the server entrypoint on the first initialization of an empty database only. The same applies to the PostgreSQL memory settings - the timescaledb image runs timescaledb-tune once, on a fresh database, sizing shared_buffers and work_mem from the memory available to the container; on an existing database they have to be changed in postgresql.conf inside the volume instead. STACKNAME is also the database name and user, so it cannot be changed once the stack has data. The Zabbix server cache and poller defaults target roughly 1300 hosts / 130 new values per second and can be lowered for a small install. Default web login is Admin / zabbix - change it after the first login.
templates.name: zabbix

env.name: STACKNAME
env.label: Unique name (or ID) of this stack
env.description: It is used as name for database, traefik, etc. String with lowercase letters, digits and underscores. It must not contain spaces, dashes etc.

env.name: APP_URL
env.label: URL
env.description: Domain name without http:// or https://

env.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
env.label: Postgresql password.
env.description: Password for the database user.

env.name: ZABBIX_TAG
env.label: Zabbix version
env.description: Image tag used for the server, frontend and agent. Stay on the 7.0 LTS line - template exports are forward compatible only, so templates tuned on a newer release may not import into 7.0.

env.name: TIMESCALEDB_TAG
env.label: TimescaleDB version
env.description: Image tag of timescale/timescaledb (community edition, i.e. no -oss suffix, which is the one with compression). 2.27.x is the ceiling accepted by the Zabbix 7.0 binary - 2.28 is refused at runtime as too new. Do not raise without checking, upgrading the extension has its own procedure.

env.name: APP_IP_WHITELIST
env.label: Allowed IP addresses
env.description: A comma separated list of IP addresses which are allowed to access this application web gui.

env.name: ZBX_CACHESIZE
env.label: Configuration cache size
env.description: Shared memory holding hosts, items and triggers. Watch the internal item zabbix[rcache,buffer,pused] and raise it before it fills up. Zabbix default is 32M.

env.name: ZBX_HISTORYCACHESIZE
env.label: History cache size
env.description: Write buffer for collected values, drained by the history syncers. Mostly idle - it is the reserve that absorbs a stall in writes to the database. Zabbix default is 16M.

env.name: ZBX_HISTORYINDEXCACHESIZE
env.label: History index cache size
env.description: Index over the history cache. Scale it together with the history cache. Zabbix default is 4M.

env.name: ZBX_VALUECACHESIZE
env.label: Value cache size
env.description: Caches historical values for trigger expressions. If it runs out the server logs a low memory warning and falls back to reading from the database on every evaluation. Zabbix default is 8M.

env.name: ZBX_TRENDCACHESIZE
env.label: Trend cache size
env.description: Caches the hourly aggregates before they are written to the trends table. Zabbix default is 4M.

env.name: ZBX_STARTPOLLERS
env.label: Pollers
env.description: Number of processes doing regular checks. Watch zabbix[process,poller,avg,busy] - if it stays near 100 percent, checks are getting late. Zabbix default is 5.

env.name: ZBX_STARTSNMPPOLLERS
env.label: SNMP pollers
env.description: Number of asynchronous SNMP pollers. Available since Zabbix 7.0, where SNMP polling no longer runs in the regular pollers. Zabbix default is 1.

env.name: ZBX_STARTPINGERS
env.label: ICMP pingers
env.description: Number of processes doing icmpping checks via fping. Zabbix default is 1.

env.name: ZBX_STARTPOLLERSUNREACHABLE
env.label: Unreachable pollers
env.description: Number of processes retrying hosts that are down. Hosts that stay permanently unreachable keep these busy, so raise this together with the retry delay below. Zabbix default is 1.

env.name: ZBX_UNAVAILABLEDELAY
env.label: Unavailable host retry delay (s)
env.description: How long to wait before retrying a host already marked unavailable. Raising it is the cheaper way to relieve saturated unreachable pollers, at the cost of noticing a recovered host that much later. Zabbix default is 60.
